summary: Primech Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing an addendum to a securities purchase agreement for a $4 million senior unsecured convertible note facility with an institutional investor. The conversion price was amended from $2.00 to $1.30 per share, and the second $2 million tranche was funded on July 7, 2026. There is no acquisition, divestiture, or special situation—this is a routine financing amendment reflecting then-current market conditions.
